item.title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
item.description:
📝 The 2bit model you deploy is the model that was trained. That is what fits 45M parameters into 14MB with nothing lost on our battery. Ship a Needle that speaks your device's tools, not a generic assistant.
🔗 Read more: https://cactuscompute.com/needle

item.title: Rust SIMD on the GPU
item.description:
📝 Rust's portable SIMD instead adds a layer of abstraction above these intrinsics. One instruction operating on many data elements is exactly what SIMD means, and the per-lane addressing that SIMT adds does not change that. A warp is a wide vector unit and a portable SIMD vector maps onto that unit directly.
🔗 Read more: https://www.vectorware.com/blog/simd-on-gpu/

item.title: Amazon backs power plant that may become top source of US climate pollution
item.description:
📝 These gas-burning plants are increasingly lumped into data center projects. Amazon told Ars that it remains committed to its Climate Pledge. But Amazon’s bottom line might take precedence over that 2040 deadline.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/08/amazon-funds-biggest-gas-power-plant-in-us-despite-climate-pledge/
